acts.title: FIRST FLIGHT
acts.blurb: Learn the ship over Abydos and Tollana: guns, missiles, the gate chain, one duel.

acts.title: THE FLEET
acts.blurb: Escorts, blockades and the hangar filling up: heavies, torpedo boats, a captured glider.

acts.title: MOTHERSHIPS
acts.blurb: Two motherships and the carrier that earns the last of them.

levels.title: CLEAR THE FIELD
levels.blurb: Three waves of death gliders in the belt. Learn the guns, learn the missiles.
intro: Gliders inbound through the belt.
Clear them before they reach the gate.
levels.finaleLine: Last wave. Interceptors with them, the quick ones.

levels.title: THE DUEL
levels.blurb: Free play. One ace, open space over the gas giant, nose to nose at 900 m, first to three. Add ?foe=glider|interceptor|gunboat|bomber to the address for a different opponent.
intro: One ship, one pilot, nothing in the way.
First to three. Do not take the head-on pass.

levels.title: THE GAUNTLET
levels.blurb: Ten gates threaded through the thickest rock in the belt, either way through. Mines on the rims; interceptors join the chase halfway.
intro: The window closes in two minutes.
The gates sit in the rock. Fly them, either way through.

levels.title: RUN IT DOWN
levels.blurb: An ace is running the gate chain out of Chulak and will escape through the last gate. Catch it before then; it only turns to fight when you are close.
intro: Courier glider on the chain, running for the far gate.
It is faster than your cruise and it knows the rock. Boost is how you catch it.

levels.title: THE TOLLAN RING
levels.blurb: Eight gates around a gas giant against four racers. Any finish counts; the podium is the point.
intro: Grid is set. Eight gates, four rivals, no guns.
Boost is your only edge. Spend it where the rock is thin.

levels.title: THE SHARD RUN
levels.blurb: Twelve tight gates through the Kheb ice field. No mines, no escorts, nothing to shoot. Just the gaps.
intro: Kheb. Ice, all of it long and sharp.
Twelve gates, close together, in the thick of the shards.
Nothing is shooting at you. The field is the enemy.

levels.title: COVER THE PROMETHEUS
levels.blurb: The Prometheus is limping to the gate with her shields down. Keep the gliders off her hull; gunboats come for the engines.
intro: Prometheus reports shields down, sublight only.
Nothing reaches her. Nothing.
levels.finaleLine: Last wave. Two gunboats, and they are going for the engines.

levels.title: BREAK THE BLOCKADE
levels.blurb: Gunboats hold the lane out of Netu's belt with interceptors screening. Kill the heavies; the screen dies with them.
intro: Blockade line ahead, gunboats anchoring it.
Missiles for the heavies. Guns for the rest.
levels.finaleLine: Three gunboats. Missiles first, then get behind them.

levels.title: THE BOMBER LINE
levels.blurb: Bombers on a straight line to the relay behind you, gliders riding with them. Every bomber that reaches the relay is a leak; three leaks and it is gone. Two and a half minutes.
intro: Bombers inbound on the relay, and they will not turn for you.
Kill the bombers. The gliders are there to make you forget that.
levels.finaleLine: Last bombers on the line. Nothing reaches the relay.

levels.title: RACE THROUGH THE WRECKS
levels.blurb: Ten gates threaded through the hulks against six racers who know the field. Tight, dark, and the walls are ships.
intro: Grid is set inside the Graveyard. Ten gates, six rivals.
They know where the gaps are. Learn fast.

levels.title: BRING THE TENDER HOME
levels.blurb: A captured tender is crawling out of Netu with a Lancer in its hold. Bombers want it. Bombers are slow, so kill them early or lose the ship.
intro: Tender is under way, thirty metres a second and no faster.
Bombers inbound. They do not turn, they do not stop. Meet them out front.
levels.finaleLine: Three bombers, and they are lined up on the tender. Torpedoes on the bombers; the rest can wait.

levels.title: HOLD THE GATE
levels.blurb: Three minutes over the home gate against everything they have. Nothing to clear, only a clock to beat. Missiles restock every half minute.
intro: They are coming through in numbers and they will keep coming.
Three minutes until the gate is ours again. Stay alive.
levels.finaleLine: Last seconds. Whatever is left, keep it off you.

levels.title: THE DESCENT
levels.blurb: Fourteen gates down through the belt over P3X-774 with three mines on every rim. Aces pick up the chase at gate five.
intro: The belt tilts here; the chain goes down through it.
Fourteen gates, mines on all of them, and someone good is waiting at the fifth.

levels.title: AMBUSH IN THE GRAVEYARD
levels.blurb: Interceptors hunting through the wreck of the last fleet. Use the hulks; they cannot turn inside them.
intro: The Graveyard. Nothing here is whole.
Interceptors, a lot of them, using the wrecks the way you should.
Get behind a hull plate before they get behind you.
levels.finaleLine: Last wave. A gunboat is in there with them. Wrecks first, then the guns.

levels.title: THE ACES OF CHULAK
levels.blurb: Their best pilots, in gold-trimmed gliders, over their own staging belt. They will not take the head-on pass. Neither should you.
intro: Chulak. Gold trim on the gliders coming up: aces.
They flinch early and they saddle late. Make them turn until they cannot.
levels.finaleLine: Last wave. Three aces. Salvage says one glider comes home in pieces if you leave one whole enough.

levels.title: BRING DOWN THE HA'TAK
levels.blurb: A Goa'uld mothership is parked over the belt behind a minefield. Ring guns first, then the three shield nodes, then the hull.
intro: Ha'tak in orbit, shields up, gliders launching.
Kill the ring guns, drop the shield nodes, then burn the pyramid.

levels.title: THE SECOND MOTHERSHIP
levels.blurb: Another Ha'tak, over Tollana this time, with aces on the ring and bombers in the hangar. Twice the mines. Same pyramid, same order: guns, nodes, hull.
intro: Second Ha'tak, and this one launched its best when we came through.
Same drill. Ring guns, shield nodes, hull. Watch the bombers when a node goes.

levels.title: PROVING GROUND
levels.blurb: No enemies, no clock. Try every move.
intro: Open space and a few rocks.
Tap B then a direction for a move; B alone for the Cobra.
